LuxLogistics Appoints New CEO to Steer Growth in Luxembourg’s Transport Sector

LuxLogistics, a leading player in Luxembourg’s transportation and logistics sector, has announced the appointment of Anne Hoffmann as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective July 1. The move is seen as a strategic step to reinforce the company’s growth ambitions and further consolidate its market presence in the Greater Region.

Hoffmann, 48, brings over two decades of experience in international freight management and supply chain operations. She joins LuxLogistics after serving as Chief Operating Officer at TransMove Europe, where she was credited with implementing digital optimisation initiatives and expanding cross-border services. Her appointment follows the retirement of Marc Weber, who led LuxLogistics for 12 years.

In a statement, LuxLogistics Chairman Jean-Paul Muller said, “Anne Hoffmann’s leadership and industry expertise are ideally suited to guide LuxLogistics through its next phase of expansion. Her commitment to innovation and sustainable logistics aligns with our long-term strategy.”

The Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce offered its congratulations, noting that the logistics sector contributes nearly 7% to the country’s GDP and supports over 15,000 jobs. “Ms. Hoffmann’s appointment comes at a pivotal time as the industry adapts to new digital and environmental standards,” said Chamber spokesperson Marie Decker.

Luxembourg’s central location in Europe and its investment in multimodal infrastructure have made the nation a vital logistics hub. According to the national statistics office, freight traffic through Luxembourg grew by 4.2% last year, driven by demand for efficient, sustainable supply chains.

Industry analysts welcomed the appointment. “Hoffmann has a proven track record in operational excellence and stakeholder collaboration, which will be crucial as LuxLogistics navigates regulatory changes and evolving customer expectations,” said Lars Schmidt of the European Logistics Institute.

In her first remarks as CEO-designate, Hoffmann stated, “I am honoured to lead LuxLogistics and look forward to working with our talented team to drive innovation and deliver value to our partners across Europe.”

LuxLogistics confirmed that a comprehensive handover process is underway and that Hoffmann will be introduced to staff and key clients over the coming weeks.
